planted.what: 240,000 paid to an Indian company under common control, up from 88,000, with no agreement, no benchmarking and no rate card behind it.
Related-party transactions with an Indian company put Form 3CEB in scope on the Indian side, and the rate used there has to match the rate deducted here. The file says nothing either way.
